project_name: SB Energy PORTS Technology Campus AI Data Center
status_detail: DOE says SB Energy announced a public-private partnership for what it describes as the world's largest AI data center on leased federal land at the Portsmouth Site; reporting describes an initial phase and supporting generation/transmission buildout.
notes: Large early-stage AI campus on DOE land; DCD reported OpenAI lease talks. Power activation/full capacity appears dependent on AEP transmission upgrades.

project_name: Stargate Lordstown AI Data Center Site
status_detail: OpenAI announced Lordstown, Ohio as one of five new U.S. Stargate AI data center sites; aggregate capacity for the five-site expansion was announced, but site-level MW was not disclosed.
notes: Keep separate from the SB Energy PORTS/Piketon project unless later evidence shows consolidation.

project_name: Bitdeer Shalersville Data Center Campus
aliases: Turnpike Commerce Center AI data center
status_detail: Bitdeer is pursuing a 15-building data center campus at Turnpike Commerce Center; public reporting cites 150MW initial and up to 750MW potential capacity, with local scrutiny and moratorium context.
notes: Early project; some sources distinguish 150MW initial capacity and 650-750MW full buildout.

project_name: Aligned Conesville Industrial Park Campus
status_detail: Aligned announced a new mega-scale AI data center campus on a 197-acre parcel in Conesville Industrial Park adjacent to the former AEP Conesville Power Plant; later company posts show construction progress.
notes: Brownfield redevelopment near retired 2GW coal plant; official release does not disclose campus MW.

project_name: Aligned NEO-01 Perkins Township Campus
status_detail: Aligned acquired a 129-acre brownfield parcel in Perkins Township for a planned four-building hyperscale campus; DCD reported the former manufacturing site was potentially expandable to more than 200MW and local news says first building is targeted for completion in 2026.
notes: Capacity is from reported expandability rather than an official committed IT-load figure.

project_name: Lakeland Equity Group Slavic Village Data Center
status_detail: A $1.6B, 150MW, three-building data center campus was proposed for 3560 E. 55th St.; Cleveland rejected the permit in May 2026, but the proposal remains important for the early-announcement superset.
notes: Status value uses approved/planned vocabulary imperfectly; status_detail records rejection. Retain as early/failed proposal.

project_name: Google New Albany Data Center Campus
status_detail: Google identifies New Albany as one of its Central Ohio data center communities; the campus began with a $600M project and later expansion commitments.
notes: Google's Central Ohio investment spans New Albany, Lancaster, and Columbus; site-level capacity not disclosed by Google.

project_name: Google Lancaster Data Center Campus
status_detail: Google lists Lancaster as an Ohio data center community; reporting says Google broke ground on the Lancaster campus in 2023 and completed the first data center in 2024.
notes: Part of Google's Central Ohio cluster and additional $2.3B 2024 investment.

project_name: Google Columbus / Lockbourne Data Center Campus
status_detail: Google lists Columbus as an Ohio data center community; DCD reported the Columbus site was under construction with expected completion by end of 2025, and later reporting says Google was constructing the Columbus campus while New Albany and Lancaster were operational.
notes: Sometimes described as Columbus South or Lockbourne.

project_name: Google Franklin Furnace Data Center
aliases: Tilted Gate LLC Scioto County data center
status_detail: Scioto County/Project Dazzler materials and DCD identify Google as the company behind a $1B, 500,000-square-foot data center complex on Gallia Pike in the Franklin Furnace area.
notes: Project Dazzler official community site gives scale and location; separate tracker estimates higher full-campus square footage/MW, not used as primary capacity.

project_name: Google Lima / Allen County Data Center
status_detail: Allen County project site and local/regional reporting identify Google as the company behind Project BOSC, a $500M data center project in the Lima area; local reporting says construction is underway.
notes: Initial Google commitment reported as $500M with local infrastructure commitments; capacity not disclosed.

project_name: Google Harrison Road NW Potential Data Center Site
aliases: 2565 Harrison Road NW Google land acquisition
status_detail: Google acquired nearly 85 acres at 2565 Harrison Road NW in New Albany for a potential data center development.
notes: Early land-acquisition signal; may later merge into an expanded Google New Albany campus.

project_name: Meta New Albany Data Center Campus
status_detail: Meta's official New Albany page reports more than $1.5B invested in Ohio and over 300 operational jobs supported; the campus has been operating and expanding since initial construction.
notes: Base operational campus; expansion/AI supercluster tracked separately below.

project_name: Meta Prometheus AI Supercluster
aliases: Meta New Albany gigawatt data center
status_detail: Multiple sources describe Meta's New Albany expansion/Prometheus as a gigawatt-scale AI supercluster due online around 2026; Meta official channels identify New Albany as the home of Prometheus, while AP reported a 1GW cluster expected to begin operations in 2026.
notes: Capacity is reported at cluster level; overlaps physically with Meta New Albany but kept as distinct major AI expansion.

project_name: Amazon Web Services New Albany Campus Expansion
aliases: Amazon New Albany data center campus
status_detail: AWS announced/planned a $3.5B New Albany expansion with five additional data centers by 2030; local New Albany reporting says the new campus is part of the 2023 planned investment and was expected to complete by the end of 2025.
notes: Part of AWS's larger Ohio investment program; site-level MW not disclosed in primary sources.

project_name: Amazon Web Services Hilliard Scioto Darby Campus
status_detail: AWS has an active Hilliard/Scioto Darby data center campus; DCD reported the third Hilliard campus plan and local Hilliard materials describe AWS installing 228 natural-gas fuel cells for the Scioto Darby Road campus with about 73MW capacity.
notes: Capacity reflects fuel-cell power system described by local materials, not necessarily total campus IT load.

project_name: Amazon Web Services Sunbury Campus
aliases: AWS Sunbury Business and Technology Park
status_detail: AWS plans a $2B data center campus at 11793 Vans Valley Road in the Sunbury Business and Technology Park; DCD says AWS purchased land for the project in early 2025.
notes: First 450,000 sq ft building reported for a long 2028-2034 construction window.

project_name: Amazon Web Services Marysville Innovation Park Campus
status_detail: Marysville says its first approved data center project is the AWS development in US 33 Innovation Park; DCD reported AWS received the green light for a $1B campus in March 2025.
notes: Marysville FAQ also references a second Marysville South data center area; AWS identity is tied to the US 33 Innovation Park project.

project_name: Marysville South Data Center Project Area
status_detail: Marysville's official FAQ states legislation supports development of a data center within the Marysville South project area and describes it as the second data center project approved by the city, with infrastructure work expected in 2026 and data center construction to follow.
notes: Developer not identified in the official FAQ; retain as early local-government project signal.

project_name: Amazon Web Services Wilmington Data Center Campus
status_detail: Clinton County Port Authority FAQ describes a 471-acre data center project at 1488 S US 68 with annexation and light-industrial zoning approved in 2025; DCD/WCPO report AWS as the proposer, with later site-plan vote delays amid community concerns.
notes: Reported as roughly $4B / 471 acres; status remains early because site plan/proceedings were delayed.

project_name: Microsoft New Albany Datacenter
aliases: Microsoft Beech Road NW data center
Microsoft Licking County New Albany site
status_detail: Microsoft says it is building datacenters in New Albany, Heath, and Hebron; its New Albany update says Ames Construction is doing first-phase construction, while DCD reports a $420M, 245,000 sq ft facility with completion slated for late 2027.
notes: Microsoft paused/slowed parts of the Licking County plan in 2025, but current Microsoft Local pages still show Ohio construction updates.

project_name: Microsoft Heath Datacenter
status_detail: Microsoft's Heath construction update says Ames Construction is the general contractor and mass grading was estimated to begin in February and complete in November 2026.
notes: Part of Microsoft's three-site Licking County program; completion of construction does not equal operational availability per Microsoft.

project_name: Microsoft Hebron Datacenter
status_detail: Microsoft's Hebron update says summer 2026 construction continues at the Hebron datacenter site, including long-term site development and substation work; local reporting notes construction began in February 2026.
notes: Early project documentation referenced a large multi-building campus; use current Microsoft status for construction.

project_name: Cologix Johnstown AI-Ready Campus
status_detail: Cologix officially announced acquisition of approximately 154 acres for an eight-data-center AI-ready campus delivering up to 800MW across 2.0M sq ft, with first phase expected to begin in 2025.
notes: Cologix also lists COL8 as a purpose-built Scalelogix data center on the Johnstown campus.

project_name: Cologix Columbus COL4 / Columbus Portfolio
status_detail: Cologix says Lambda deployed NVIDIA HGX B200 clusters at COL4; the same release says Cologix has four Columbus data centers totaling 500,000 sq ft and 80MW of power.
notes: Operational colocation/interconnection footprint; included because it is an active AI/data center project location, not just a planned campus.

project_name: QTS New Albany 1 and New Albany 2 Campus
status_detail: DCD reports QTS plans New Albany 1 at 675 Beech Road SW with 144MW and New Albany 2 at 785 Beech Road SW with 78MW across two buildings; local reporting says construction began in 2024 with completion targeted in 2025.
notes: Capacity is sum of reported New Albany 1 and 2 critical power figures.

project_name: QTS Babbitt Road / Miller Road Expansion
aliases: QTS Babbitt and Miller roads campus
status_detail: Baxtel and related tracker data report QTS wants eight additional facilities spanning 3.2M sq ft on 240 acres around Babbitt and Miller roads, investing nearly $3B beyond its initial New Albany commitments.
notes: Early expansion signal; keep distinct from QTS New Albany 1/2 because source describes eight additional facilities.

project_name: Vantage OH1 New Albany Campus
status_detail: Vantage officially broke ground on a 70-acre New Albany campus with three two-story hyperscale data centers totaling 192MW and 1.5M sq ft; first phase was expected live in 2025.
notes: Vantage's first Midwest campus.

project_name: STACK Infrastructure NAL01 Campus
status_detail: STACK officially lists NAL01 in New Albany with 60MW of critical capacity across two buildings, including 48MW of new secured utility-powered capacity; later reporting shows a NAL01B expansion proposal.
notes: Operational campus with expansion; exact NAL01B status should be rechecked in city permit records.

project_name: EdgeConneX New Albany / Johnstown South Campus
status_detail: DCD reports EdgeConneX acquired a warehouse and adjacent land along Innovation Campus Way and plans more than 1M sq ft of data center space; an economic-development post describes an 80MW conversion plus two future 72MW facilities.
notes: Capacity combines 80MW conversion and two 72MW future facilities from OEDA social post; verify against filings when available.

project_name: CyrusOne New Albany COL-1
status_detail: CyrusOne broke ground on a New Albany data center at 12181 Jug St. in 2025; DCD earlier reported a $150M project and later social/company-related posts describe 36MW initial scaling to 180MW.
notes: DCD did not disclose MW; 180MW is from CyrusOne LinkedIn/social snippet, so retain with caution.

project_name: Edged Columbus Data Center
status_detail: Edged officially opened its New Albany facility, delivering 24MW of critical capacity and waterless cooling for AI workloads; DCD reports the two-story facility spans 206,000 sq ft.
notes: Address appears in sources as 6525/6526 New Albany Road East; normalize at later geocoding stage.

project_name: Karis Critical New Albany Data Center Site
status_detail: DCD reported Karis Critical purchased 115 acres at 4500 Beech Road NW in New Albany for a data center project; details and capacity were not disclosed.
notes: Land acquisition/early announcement; keep as separate until plans are filed or merged with a named campus.
